Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers in a tetrahedral environment with 4 S neighbors, and Er centers with 8 S neighbors, while each S center has 2 Cu neighbors. The tetrahedra share corners and edges, and the 8-vertex Er polyhedra share corners and faces with the Cu tetrahedra, forming a 3-dimensional neighbor graph.
